selection_rationale: The selected skill is explicitly centered on sandbox/live parity, API contract regressions, structured outputs, and automated regression workflows for AI-assisted systems.
It is easier than speech-model tasks to keep oracle behavior deterministic inside a single-container Harbor task while still preserving a realistic runtime chain.
The task can keep with_skill and without_skill variants identical except for environment/skills/ and its runtime copy logic.

rejected_high_star_skills.reason: Would push the template toward model downloads, inference-time variability, and higher runtime cost in E2B.
More suitable for skill-authoring workflows than for a realistic runtime service-repair benchmark.
Task surface is too narrow and is less likely to preserve a meaningful with_skill versus without_skill gap.
Depends on external workspace permissions and may involve private enterprise content.

task_shape.domain: intent routing, escalation, and evidence-backed suggestions
task_shape.runtime: single-container Node.js service with local provider simulator and local data fixtures
task_shape.solver_action: repair the existing service and regression surface instead of replacing it with a report or mock

planned_verifier_focus: Batch triage completeness without silent drops
Evidence-field presence and empty-evidence fallback behavior
Guardrails against hardcoded fixture-only logic and simulator bypass

real_data_sources.reference_type: in-domain support-ticket text and intent semantics
provider request and response message shape

with_without_difference_policy: Only environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime copy/removal logic may differ between with_skill and without_skill variants.
non_goals_before_experiments: Do not modify any existing skill.
Do not let with_skill and without_skill diverge in anything except environment/skills/ and the corresponding runtime copy logic.

notes: Oracle remained stable in isolated E2B environments.
The final verifier keeps output-contract checks and adds a workflow guardrail tied to the bound ai-regression-testing skill.
Recent probe runs still show some model randomness on with_skill, but without_skill remained strictly worse across the latest three effective trials.
